review:
Raging Waterfall Megaways is an underwater Megaways slot with a Multi Chance feature: if matching symbols land on reels 2 to 6 but not on reel one, the first reel expands and respins to try to complete the win.

Four scatters award eight free spins, plus two for each extra scatter. Scatters landing in the bonus activate a modifier: +1 free spin, +1x to wins, removal of the lowest symbol, or more wilds. Multi Chance continues during the feature. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. The Multi Chance respin softens the frustration of near misses.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
